about: Known-answer cases for sg:stock-act-ptr-after-deadline:v1 (docs/signals/stock-act-ptr-after-deadline.md). Dates and placeholders only: no case is a person, and none ever enters data/. Every expected answer was worked by hand from the calendar, the first twenty-six before the implementations existed and the rest after the Council's reading of 2026-09-26 changed the criteria; both implementations are tested against these, and neither wrote them.
rule: The deadline for a transaction is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date, in calendar days, and it does not move when it falls on a weekend or holiday. Where the report prints no notification date, or one that cannot be read, or one before the transaction date or after the report's own date, the 30-day limit is not applied and the deadline is 45 days after the transaction. A report is after the deadline for a transaction when the Clerk's index dates the report later than the deadline. When the two limits fall on the same day, the 45-day limit is named as setting it. A row is evaluated only when it is marked New, its asset is coded ST, CS, OP or CT (and, coded ST, not named as an ETF), its amount is over $1,000, it is dated on or after this Congress's swearing-in and on or before the report, and its deadline falls in 2025 or later.

cases.name: the forty-fifth day
cases.why: 2025-01-02 + 45 days is 2025-02-16 (29 days to 2025-01-31, 16 more); 2025-01-20 + 30 is 2025-02-19. The 45-day limit is earlier. A report dated on the deadline itself is not after it. The officeholder was sworn in a Congress earlier, so the transaction falls inside the time the rule applies; with a swearing-in of 2025-01-03 the row would not be evaluated at all, which is what the first draft of this case forgot and the implementation caught.

cases.name: the forty-sixth day
cases.why: The same transaction, reported one day later: after the 45-day limit by 1 day, although within 30 days of the notification date. Sworn a Congress earlier, as in the case above. 2025-02-16 is a Sunday and Monday 2025-02-17 was Washington's Birthday, so the first business day after the deadline is 2025-02-18, and the report is dated before it.

cases.name: the thirtieth day
cases.why: Notified on the day of the transaction, 2025-03-03: 30 days later is 2025-04-02 (28 days to 2025-03-31, 2 more), earlier than 45 days (2025-04-17). A report dated 2025-04-02 is on the deadline.

cases.name: the thirty-first day
cases.why: The same transaction reported a day later: after the 30-day limit by 1 day, although within 45 days of the transaction.

cases.name: the 45-day limit binds inside 30 days of notice
cases.why: Notified 19 days after the transaction. 45 days after 2025-05-01 is 2025-06-15; 30 days after 2025-05-20 is 2025-06-19. The earlier binds, so a report dated 2025-06-17 is 2 days after the deadline though inside 30 days of the notice.

cases.name: the two limits fall on the same day
cases.why: Notified exactly 15 days after the transaction, so 30 days after notice and 45 days after the transaction are both 2025-08-15. The 45-day limit is named as setting it.

cases.name: notified after the 45-day limit had passed
cases.why: 45 days after 2025-01-28 is 2025-03-14 (3 days to 2025-01-31, 28 in February, 14 more). The report prints notification on 2025-03-18, after that, and is dated the same day: 4 days after the deadline, which had passed before the notification. The Finding must say so.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-03-18, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 4 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the report prints a notification date later than 45 days after the transaction, so the deadline had passed before that notification; the Clerk's index dates the report the same day as that notification.

cases.name: notification printed before the transaction
cases.why: The report prints notice nine days before the transaction, which cannot be the notice the rule means. The 30-day limit is not applied; 45 days after 2025-04-10 is 2025-05-25, so a report dated 2025-05-05 is on time. Applying the 30-day limit to the printed date would have put it 4 days after 2025-05-01, a claim the record does not support.

cases.name: no notification date printed, past 45 days
cases.why: Without a notification date only the 45-day limit can be applied: 45 days after 2025-07-01 is 2025-08-15, and a report dated 2025-08-20 is 5 days after it.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-08-20, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 5 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the report prints no usable notification date, so the deadline is 45 days after the transaction.

cases.name: no notification date printed, inside 45 days
cases.why: The 30-day limit cannot be applied without a notification date, so the report is not said to be after it; within 45 days of the transaction the Signal is silent.

cases.name: notification printed after the report's own date
cases.why: A report cannot follow a notice it predates. The 30-day limit is not applied; 45 days after 2025-09-01 is 2025-10-16 (29 days to 2025-09-30, 16 more), so a report dated 2025-10-10 is on time.

cases.name: a notification date that cannot be read
cases.why: A notification date not in the form YYYY-MM-DD is not read and the 30-day limit is not applied. 45 days after 2025-05-01 is 2025-06-15; a report dated 2025-06-10 is on time.

cases.name: a row the filer marked Amended
cases.why: An amendment is filed after the report it amends; the rule measures the original. Not evaluated, though its dates alone would put it far after.

cases.name: a row the filer marked Deleted
cases.why: A row the filer withdrew is not evaluated.

cases.name: a row with no filing status printed
cases.why: The Signal evaluates rows the report marks New. A row with no status is not evaluated rather than assumed New.

cases.name: a transaction dated before this Congress's swearing-in
cases.why: The roster records the swearing-in for this Congress, not the start of a person's service, and the register holds no earlier index against which a transaction dated before it could be checked for an earlier report. Not evaluated, and counted.

cases.name: no swearing-in date recorded
cases.why: Without the date the roster records, the Signal cannot say the rule applied on the transaction date. Not evaluated.

cases.name: a transaction dated after the report
cases.why: A report cannot list a transaction that had not happened. The dates contradict each other, and the Signal does not decide which is right.

cases.name: a transaction date that does not parse
cases.why: There is no 30 February. A transaction date that is not a real calendar date is not read, and the row is not evaluated.

cases.name: a report the register did not read
cases.why: A scanned paper report is captured and not read; its transaction dates are printed in the document, which the register does not read. No row is evaluated and the report is counted as not read.

cases.name: a report date that cannot be read
cases.why: Without the Clerk's date for the report there is nothing to set beside the deadline. The report is not evaluated.

cases.name: the leap day
cases.why: 2028 is a leap year: 30 days after 2028-02-15 is 2028-03-16 (14 days to 2028-02-29, 16 more), a Thursday; in a common year it would be 03-17. A report dated 2028-03-17 is after the deadline by 1 day. The case moved from 2024 to 2028 when the Council's reading limited this version to deadlines in 2025 and later.

cases.name: across the new year
cases.why: 30 days after 2024-12-20 is 2025-01-19 (11 days to 2024-12-31, 19 more), a Sunday. A report dated 2025-01-21 is 2 days after. Monday 2025-01-20 was the Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr., so the first business day after the deadline is 2025-01-21, the report's own date.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-01-21, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 2 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the deadline fell on a Sunday, and the Clerk's index dates the report on or before the first business day after it, 2025-01-21 (Birthday of Martin Luther King, Jr., 2025-01-20, was a federal holiday); the Committee's instructions for these reports state that a due date on a weekend or holiday does not move.

cases.name: a deadline on a Sunday
cases.why: 30 days after 2025-05-09 is 2025-06-08 (22 days to 2025-05-31, 8 more), a Sunday (2025-06-01 was a Sunday). The Committee's instructions state that the date does not move, so a report dated Monday 2025-06-09 is after it by 1 day, and the Finding says the report is dated the first business day after it, because that is what decides it.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-06-09, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 1 day. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the deadline fell on a Sunday, and the Clerk's index dates the report on or before the first business day after it, 2025-06-09; the Committee's instructions for these reports state that a due date on a weekend or holiday does not move.

cases.name: the same day
cases.why: Traded, notified and reported on one day: on time.

cases.name: one report, three rows
cases.why: The first row's deadline is 2025-04-02 (30 days after notice), 8 days before the report's date; the second's is 2025-04-19 (30 days after 2025-03-20), after it; the third is marked Amended and not evaluated. One Finding for the report, naming the first row only.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-04-10, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for 1 of the 2 transactions on it that this Signal evaluated, by 8 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)).

cases.name: an asset coded GS
cases.why: The report codes the asset GS, government securities. Whether the Committee's instructions put them on these reports is not settled in what the register has read, so this version does not evaluate the row, though its dates alone would put it after.

cases.name: a stock code on an asset named as an ETF
cases.why: The filer coded the asset ST, but its printed name calls it an ETF, a widely held fund the Committee's instructions keep off these reports. Not evaluated.

expect.reason: coded as a stock, named as an ETF

cases.name: no asset code printed
cases.why: Without the code the report prints for the asset, the Signal cannot say the rule reaches it. Not evaluated.

cases.name: the $1,000 threshold
cases.why: The rule reaches transactions over $1,000. An exact $1,000.00, carried as the whole dollars on either side of it, 1,000 to 1,000, is not over it; an exact $1,000.50, carried as 1,000 to 1,001, is. Both are within 30 days of their notice.

cases.name: a deadline before 2025
cases.why: 30 days after 2024-10-01 is 2024-10-31. The Committee's instructions before 2025 have not always said the same thing about a due date on a weekend, and the register has read only the CY 2025 form, so a row whose deadline falls before 2025 is not evaluated.

cases.name: a Saturday deadline, a holiday Monday, the Tuesday after
cases.why: 30 days after 2025-07-31 is 2025-08-30, a Saturday; 45 days after is 2025-09-14. Monday 2025-09-01 was Labor Day, so the first business day after the deadline is Tuesday 2025-09-02, the report's date: after the deadline by 3 days, 33 days after the notice.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-09-02, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 3 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the deadline fell on a Saturday, and the Clerk's index dates the report on or before the first business day after it, 2025-09-02 (Labor Day, 2025-09-01, was a federal holiday); the Committee's instructions for these reports state that a due date on a weekend or holiday does not move.

cases.name: a Sunday deadline the report is dated well after
cases.why: 30 days after 2025-05-09 is Sunday 2025-06-08. The report is dated 2025-06-20, after the first business day after the deadline too, so the weekend decides nothing and the sentence does not mention it: 12 days after, 42 days after the notice.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-06-20, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 12 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)).

cases.name: a deadline on a weekday holiday
cases.why: 30 days after 2025-06-04 is Friday 2025-07-04, Independence Day. The first business day after it is Monday 2025-07-07, the report's date: 3 days after, 33 days after the notice.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-07-07, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 3 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the deadline fell on Independence Day, a federal holiday, and the Clerk's index dates the report on or before the first business day after it, 2025-07-07; the Committee's instructions for these reports state that a due date on a weekend or holiday does not move.

cases.name: notified after the limit, reported a week after the notice
cases.why: 45 days after Monday 2025-01-06 is Thursday 2025-02-20 (25 days to 2025-01-31, 20 more). The report prints notice on 2025-03-03, after that, so 30 days after notice (2025-04-02) does not bind. A report dated 2025-03-10 is 18 days after the deadline and 7 days after the notice, and the sentence says both.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2025-03-10, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 18 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the report prints a notification date later than 45 days after the transaction, so the deadline had passed before that notification; the Clerk's index dates the report 7 days after it.

cases.name: a holiday observed on another day
cases.why: 45 days after 2026-05-19 is Friday 2026-07-03 (12 days to 2026-05-31, 30 in June, 3 more); 30 days after the notice of 2026-06-10 is 07-10. 2026-07-04 is a Saturday, so Independence Day is observed on Friday 07-03, and the first business day after is Monday 2026-07-06, the report's date: 3 days after, 26 days after the notice.

expect.description: The Clerk's index dates this report 2026-07-06, which is later than the deadline the rule sets for the one transaction on it that this Signal evaluated, by 3 days. The deadline is the earlier of 30 days after the notification date the report prints and 45 days after the transaction date (5 U.S.C. § 13105(l)). For that transaction the deadline fell on Independence Day (observed), a federal holiday, and the Clerk's index dates the report on or before the first business day after it, 2026-07-06; the Committee's instructions for these reports state that a due date on a weekend or holiday does not move.
